summary: RECOVERY (2nd launch) of the beat-free tube representation. The tube surrogate stored the raw SACR-C envelope E(w), which beats as cos(w*Delta_tau) from an unresolved merging fold pair, costing ~48 angular nodes. The fix (substantially COMPLETE in the working tree at coder checkpoint 980f7e3d) changes the REPRESENTATION not the coordinate: `_tube_f_ref` (surrogate.py) computes a non-vanishing q=p uniform-Airy reference F_ref by importing `_merging_fold_pair`+`airy_fold_value` from `_airy_fold` (DRY, never re-derived); the builder stores r = E/F_ref and the serve re-multiplies E = r*F_ref at the RAW eigenframe query source (F_ref is D2-invariant); a TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY envelope-definition tag + stale-artifact hard-refusal are live; the dead s'/TV axis was correctly NOT carried (theta_to_s stays arc-length). The Professor validated the representation as physically correct (Q1 PASS, DO NOT escalate: q=p is non-vanishing by the Airy Wronskian; the surviving sub-leading ripple at rate w*Delta_tau has O(1) amplitude that does not grow with w, so the node collapse is real; collapse quality tracks p_true~=p which holds best in the near-caustic shell the tube samples). The first launch died at test-reconciliation (test_dev max_turns during Inspector revision 1, findings never recorded), NOT at implementation, so residual risk lives in tests plus two verification points in production: (1) confirm `_tube_serves` probes F_ref at the RAW source so the serve-time None->RuntimeError stays unreachable; (2) confirm lobe/wedge/exterior serve paths are BYTE-IDENTICAL to HEAD. This plan is ONE Coder WP (audit-and-close the production surface + delete the orphan test file) plus Test-Developer test reconciliation and the F083 falsification test via domain_test_descriptions. ASSUMPTIONS (documented per non-interactive pipeline): the 2-impl+1-design Inspector findings from launch 1 were never written down; the Coder self-review + the standard Inspector/Professor gates will re-surface them, and WP1 targets the Professor's concrete watch items which are their most likely content. ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE required in the completion record: the F083 (nodes, eps) pair for gamma=0.4 astroid arcs[0] — the permanent test pins n_theta=10 at eps<=0.0237; the Test Developer must quote the measured eps. The >24-node escalation tripwire stands: if the beat-free residual cannot meet 0.0237 at <=24 nodes, STOP and escalate rather than brute-force. Contracts/SPEC fragments are handled by the post-build doc-sync/Librarian phase, not a WP (the contracts fragment already exists untracked in the tree).

work_packages.how: STEP 0 (cleanup first, it unblocks test collection): delete cogwheel/tests/test_lensing_tube_nyquist_coordinate.py entirely (git rm / remove). It imports the DEAD graduation symbol family `_tube_delay_map`, `theta_to_s_prime`, `_TUBE_AXIS_SCHEMA`, `_validate_tube_axis_schema` which do not exist in production; it is untracked debris from the superseded s'/TV-axis plan. The DRY `_merging_fold_pair` pin and the beat-free invariants live in test_lensing_tube_beat_free.py (owned by the Test Developer), so this deletion loses no coverage. Confirm `python -m pytest cogwheel/tests/ --collect-only -q` no longer errors on this file. STEP 1 (Professor watch item — candidate impl finding): verify `_tube_serves` probes `_tube_f_ref` at the RAW eigenframe query source (source_q = [y1_eig, y2_eig]) over the SAME covering w-grid the serve uses, NOT a theta-folded source. The serve-side `_evaluate_chart` tube branch raises RuntimeError when F_ref is None on the claim 'unreachable after _tube_serves'. That claim is only true if gate and serve reach the identical None decision. Grep every call site of `_tube_f_ref` (`mcp__serena__find_referencing_symbols`) and confirm the gate and serve call it with the same (raw source, w-grid). If they diverge, FIX the gate to probe at the raw source so the RuntimeError stays unreachable in production. STEP 2: confirm F_ref uses q=p (equal amplitudes), NOT the shipped q=0 — the call must be `airy_fold_value(w, tau_bar, xi_w, p_amplitude, p_amplitude, sigma)`. The Professor confirmed q=p is the correct non-vanishing reference (Airy Wronskian: Ai and Ai' share no zero). Do NOT change this to the physical (p, q=0); that reintroduces a carrier zero. STEP 3: confirm the dead axis is gone — TubeChart carries `theta_to_s` as ARC-LENGTH (not `theta_to_s_prime`); no `_tube_delay_map` / `theta_to_s_prime` / `_TUBE_AXIS_SCHEMA` symbol survives in cogwheel/lensing/ production. Grep to prove absence. STEP 4 (BYTE-IDENTICAL constraint — prior graduation broke LobeUCoorDBound...): confirm the lobe/wedge/exterior/far-field serve and build paths are byte-identical to HEAD; the residual demodulation must be gated strictly inside `isinstance(chart, TubeChart)` branches. Use `git diff` on surrogate.py/surrogate_training.py and confirm every hunk is tube-only. STEP 5 (part0 absorber-guard pre-clearance): the one new module constant TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY must clear the part0 absorber naming guard — either it is already allowlisted/justified or its name follows the guard's accepted pattern. If the guard trips, add an allowlist-with-justification entry (the F-sweep DRY precedent) rather than renaming a schema tag that is already serialized. Do NOT invent new measured constants — the representation must stay analytic. STEP 6: confirm the engine-free census wiring (tiling_census.py tube verdict) still collects and references the tube chart consistently after any change; if the census imports a now-deleted symbol, repair the import (thin-caller only, never reimplement selection logic). Do NOT expand census scope. Leave changelog/completed/contracts/SPEC fragments to the doc-sync phase — do NOT write them here.

domain_test_descriptions: F083 ACCURACY FALSIFICATION (permanent fast test, Professor Q3, authoritative — this is the build's load-bearing accuracy pin AND the source of the (nodes, eps) figure that must be quoted in the completion record). SETUP: astroid band bracketing gamma=0.4 (reuse the existing fixture constants _BAND=(0.37,0.43), _GAMMA=0.4); `band_caustic_structure` at N=200 samples; select arcs[0] via `_tube_training_arcs(structure, parity=+1)`; build ONE TubeChart on the TRIMMED servable sub-arc (reuse the shared fixture/build path that trims — do NOT build on the full cusp-to-cusp arc, which raises 'not strictly increasing' from the live _tube_delay_map monotonicity defect regardless of representation correctness); eta shell via eta_max = f_max*R_c at f_max=0.40 passed as an explicit kwarg; build at n_theta = 10 angular nodes. OPERATION: place 8 held-out (gamma=0.4, y1_eig, y2_eig) points at the 8 midpoints of the interior build-node theta intervals (OFF-node — on-node points round-trip exactly and measure nothing) at a fixed mid-shell eta = 0.5*eta_max, converting (eta,theta)->(y1_eig,y2_eig) via `_tube_source` (the same inward-normal map the builder uses, guaranteeing 4-image interior). Serve each via `_evaluate_chart` (r_interp*F_ref at the raw held-out source) and compare to the shipping ChangRefsdalChannels.evaluate oracle (exact_total demodulated to the SACR-C E — call the shipping code, never a re-transcription). EXPECTED: eps = max over held-out points, max over w in the chart w-grid intersected with [40,80], of |E_served - E_exact| / max_w|F_ref| satisfies eps <= 0.0237. Use F_ref-magnitude normalization (NOT |E|-normalization, which spikes spuriously at Airy nodes). A regression that leaves the residual beating needs ~48 nodes and blows past 0.0237 at 10 by a wide margin. The test must expose the measured eps (e.g. via assertion message or a reported value) so the completion record can quote the (n_theta=10, eps=<measured>) pair. DIAGNOSTIC: plot E_served and E_exact vs w over [40,80] at one held-out point — a surviving beat shows as an un-tracked cos(w*Delta_tau) oscillation. If eps cannot reach 0.0237 at <=24 nodes, STOP and escalate (representation is wrong).

NON-VANISHING F_ref GUARD (Professor Q4a; likely already pinned in test_lensing_tube_beat_free.py — reconcile to this spec). SETUP: gamma=0.4 astroid, a servable arc source; evaluate F_ref across the design w-band specifically AT the first Airy zeros xi in {2.338, 4.088, 5.521} where the physical q=0 form vanishes exactly. OPERATION: compute |_tube_f_ref(...)| at those w. EXPECTED: |F_ref| / (2*sqrt(pi)*p*max_w[w^{1/6}]) >= 1e-8 (a deliberately loose floor: the q=p form clears zero by ~8 orders; the guard only catches a regression to q=0 which lands exactly on zero). Oracle for the Airy-zero locations: independent scipy.special.airy, not the production bracket. DIAGNOSTIC: |F_ref| vs xi across a zero — a dip to ~0 signals a q=0 regression and serve-side division by a carrier zero.

ROUND-TRIP RECONSTRUCTION IDENTITY (Professor Q4b; reconcile existing pin). SETUP: build a small tube chart on a servable astroid arc; pick BUILD-node (u,theta) samples. OPERATION: confirm E_served = r_stored * F_ref(node) reproduces the stored engine envelope, and reconstruct_from_envelope of that reproduces exact_total, both at the SAME query source. EXPECTED: rtol 1e-12, atol 0 (the SACR-C reconstruction algebra is exact; only float64 round-off remains). DIAGNOSTIC: a wrong-frame carrier (F_ref referenced to tau_bar instead of tau_c, or a build/serve frame mismatch) is a whole-number relative error, nowhere near 1e-12. Failure mode guarded: carrier/frame convention drift between build and serve.

D2 INVARIANCE OF F_ref (Professor Q4c; reconcile existing pin — note this is the ENGINE-LAYER D2 pin, DISTINCT from and complementary to the SERVE-LAYER D2 equality in test_lensing_tube_d2_fold.py; label both classes so a future reader does not collapse or triplicate them). SETUP: a servable astroid source y=(y1,y2); form the three non-trivial D2 reflections (-y1,-y2), (-y1,y2), (y1,-y2). OPERATION: compare F_ref(reflected) to F_ref(y) PER w-node (not aggregate). EXPECTED: negation-only (-y1,-y2) matches to ~1e-14; the single-axis reflections match to rtol 1e-11 (delays are computed and accumulate ~1 ULP through the pi-theta arithmetic); assert the engine envelope's own D2 invariance to 1e-12. DIAGNOSTIC: per-w comparison catches a single-w phase flip that an averaged norm would hide. Failure mode guarded: a refactor that theta-folds F_ref (breaking the 'serve at raw eigenframe' correctness) or a non-even coordinate leak.

LARGE-XI CALIBRATION / FACTOR-OF-TWO LOCK (Professor Q4d; KEEP the reformulated CoV pin — do NOT revert to a geometric-two-image-sum equality, which certifies a convention production does not use). SETUP: fix a servable fold with Delta_tau such that w*Delta_tau sweeps [40, 200]. OPERATION: form the ratio F_ref / S_asymp where S_asymp is the independently-derived q=p stationary-phase asymptote ~ const*exp(-i(zeta - pi/4)) with zeta = w*Delta_tau/2 and xi = (3*w*Delta_tau/4)^{2/3} using the FULL Delta_tau = tau_minus - tau_plus. EXPECTED: coefficient of variation of |F_ref/S_asymp| and of arg(F_ref/S_asymp) < 1.5e-2 (a single w-independent complex constant). DIAGNOSTIC: a factor-of-two in zeta (half vs full DT) breaks constancy by O(10); a wrong sigma rotates the phase constant. This locks the exact factor-of-two convention (full DT, not half) the code committed to.

DRY _merging_fold_pair CONSUMPTION (Professor Q4e; reconcile existing pin — this replaces the DRY coverage lost when the orphan nyquist file is deleted). SETUP: patch the `_merging_fold_pair` binding IN THE surrogate MODULE NAMESPACE (surrogate._merging_fold_pair, which `_tube_f_ref` resolves at import — patching cogwheel.lensing.chang_refsdal._airy_fold._merging_fold_pair is a SILENT NO-OP giving a false green). OPERATION: (1) assert the spy is called >= 1 time during a F_ref evaluation; (2) perturb the spy's returned pair (inflate Delta_tau) and assert F_ref MEASURABLY moves (its beat phase shifts). EXPECTED: both hold — proving the pair value is CONSUMED, not merely touched. DIAGNOSTIC: if inflating Delta_tau leaves F_ref unchanged, a local re-derivation of Delta_tau has crept in, breaking DRY and letting the fold-pair convention drift.

FOUR-BAND BUILDABILITY SMOKE (Professor Q4f; reconcile existing pin — explicitly LABEL this a buildability smoke, not an accuracy invariant; its unique value is guarding the Q2 whole-arc-refusal risk, chiefly the SADDLE gamma=1.2 deltoid whose short cusp-flanked arcs can drop below 4 images or land in cusp exclusion end-to-end). SETUP: astroid gamma in {0.045, 0.4, large} and saddle gamma=1.2, each on its selected arc/trimmed sub-arc. OPERATION: build the tube chart AND serve at least one interior held-out query per band. EXPECTED: build returns without error AND the interior query serves a FINITE envelope (the strengthening — do not accept 'the constructor ran' alone). DIAGNOSTIC: a band that builds but serves NaN/None signals whole-arc F_ref refusal (merging pair complex/absent across the arc).

RE-POINT EXISTING PINS FOR THE NEW REPRESENTATION (parsimony contract — RE-POINT, never rewrite suites; this is the reconciliation work that exhausted launch 1's budget, so scope it tightly). In test_lensing_tube_d2_fold.py: any pin that asserted a property of the OLD raw-envelope serve must be re-pointed to the residual-serve output (E = r*F_ref); the D2 serve-equality should still hold because F_ref is D2-invariant, so update expected values only where the stored tensor is now the residual, not the assertion's intent. In test_lensing_surrogate.py: audit tube-related tests (around _find_real_tube_source / the tube selection path, ~L2303-2374) for any test that queries with an arbitrary synthetic (y1_eig,y2_eig) that now declines or hits the _tube_f_ref path — re-point those to a real servable tube source (per the existing INS-1-001 note) or assert the decline explicitly; do NOT loosen a tolerance or delete an assertion to make it pass — RE-DERIVE the expected value from the live production serve. EXPECTED: both suites collect and pass green with expectations re-derived from the current residual representation, no orphaned references to the deleted nyquist file, and no duplicated arc-build fixture (reuse the shared fixture).

professor_inputs: Q1 PASS, DO NOT escalate: q=p uniform-Airy F_ref is a legitimate non-vanishing demodulation reference (Airy Wronskian — Ai and Ai' share no zero, |F_ref|^2 = 4pi p^2 (w^{1/3}Ai(-xi)^2 + w^{-1/3}Ai'(-xi)^2) > 0). Using q=p rather than the physical (p,q=0) is correct because F_ref only carries the carrier+beat and stays non-vanishing; physical amplitude structure is recovered by the interpolated residual.

Q1b: dividing by the q=p reference cancels the fast carrier and the LEADING beat amplitude; a sub-leading ripple at rate w*Delta_tau survives but has O(1) amplitude that does NOT grow with w (w^{-1/3}Ai'/Ai ~ O(1) since xi ∝ w^{2/3}) and is smooth/analytic — a cubic spline resolves it with a modest node budget, so the collapse is real. Collapse quality tracks p_true≈p, best in the near-caustic shell the tube samples (self-consistent).

Q2: isolated-node zero-fill + serve-time None->RuntimeError are SAFE. WATCH (candidate launch-1 impl finding): verify _tube_serves probes F_ref at the RAW (not theta-folded) source on the same w-grid so the RuntimeError stays unreachable. Whole-arc refusal risk is confined to the saddle gamma=1.2 deltoid (short cusp-flanked arcs); the buildability smoke is the correct guard. The F083 fixture MUST build on the TRIMMED servable sub-arc — the full cusp-to-cusp arc raises 'not strictly increasing' from the live _tube_delay_map monotonicity defect regardless of representation correctness.

Q3: F083 is a feasible <60s permanent test — build astroid gamma=0.4 arcs[0] (trimmed) at n_theta=10, 8 OFF-node held-out points at mid-shell eta=0.5*eta_max interleaved between build nodes, eps = F_ref-normalized max relative error over held-out x w∈[40,80] vs the shipping ChangRefsdalChannels.evaluate oracle, threshold eps<=0.0237 (spec bar, untightened — the low node count carries the falsification power, a beating residual needs ~48).

Q4 tolerances endorsed: non-vanish floor 1e-8 checked at Airy zeros; round-trip rtol 1e-12; D2 F_ref 1e-11 / engine env 1e-12 per-w-node over 3 non-trivial octants; KEEP the reformulated large-xi CoV<1.5e-2 pin (do NOT revert to a geometric-sum equality — locks the full-DT factor-of-2 convention); DRY spy must patch surrogate._merging_fold_pair and assert the value is CONSUMED (perturb Delta_tau -> F_ref moves); the four-band buildability is a SMOKE test (not an accuracy invariant), strengthened to require >=1 finite served query per band.
